result.summary: The page is mostly polished, but the bottom navigation shows an incorrect active state and the horizontal category row ends with an awkward clipped control.

issues.description: The screen displays the Home/discovery feed, but “Profile” is highlighted in green while “Home” is inactive. This makes the current navigation state inconsistent with the visible page.
issues.suggestion: Mark “Home” as the active tab on this screen and reserve the green Profile state for the profile page.

issues.description: The category row shows only a blank sliver of the next pill at the right edge, which looks accidentally cropped rather than intentionally scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Adjust chip spacing or initial scroll position so part of the next chip’s label is visible, or clip the row cleanly and add a clearer horizontal-scroll affordance.
